title: Signal: Base64 basic-auth credential in the client configuration
scope: A .npmrc file that declares a base64 `user:password` credential written into the checked-in client configuration.
limitations: It matches a base64 `user:password` credential written into the checked-in client configuration in the parsed .npmrc; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A .npmrc that mentions a base64 `user:password` credential written into the checked-in client configuration in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
